definitions.gloss: award ceremony; awards ceremony; prize-giving ceremony
definitions.explanation: A formal event at which prizes or awards are presented to recipients. Used for literary prizes, film awards, academic honors, and other recognition events.

examples.japanese: {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will attend the award ceremony.

examples.japanese: {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{感動的|かんどうてき}→感動的：25931_kandouteki⟧な⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A moving speech was given at the award ceremony.

examples.japanese: ノーベル⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧ストックホルム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Nobel Prize award ceremony is held in Stockholm every year.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧ ('receiving a prize') and {式|しき} ('ceremony'). Follows the productive {〜式|しき} pattern: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ ('graduation ceremony'), ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧ ('wedding ceremony'), ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧ ('entrance ceremony').

USAGE:
- Commonly encountered in news about film, literature, music, and academic awards
- The word focuses on the ceremony itself, not the act of winning — for the latter, use ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧
- Often modified by the name of the specific award: ノーベル⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend an award ceremony
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold an award ceremony
- {受賞式|じゅしょうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧: award ceremony speech
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{受賞式|じゅしょうしき}: annual award ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {授賞式|じゅしょうしき}: award-giving ceremony — same reading, written with {授|じゅ} ('to grant') instead of {受|じゅ} ('to receive'); focuses on the giver's perspective
- ⟦{表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}→表彰式：20175_hyoushoushiki⟧: commendation ceremony — broader, includes recognition of merit not limited to prizes
- ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧: ceremony — general term for any formal ceremony
